nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Changes Warning
nodes.rationale: This project's Next.js version diverges from training data: APIs, conventions, and file structure may all differ, so agents must consult the bundled docs and heed deprecation notices before writing any code.

nodes.label: Wix Webhook Handler
nodes.description: POST endpoint for Wix payment/ecom webhooks. Processes JWT-encoded webhook payloads from Wix (order_paid events). Requires secondary API call to Wix to fetch full order details with buyer email.

nodes.label: Forgot Password Page
nodes.description: Client component for password reset flow. Collects email, sends reset request to /api/auth/forgot, displays confirmation UI.

nodes.label: Instructor Evaluations Page
nodes.description: Instructor portal for evaluating student written tests. Separates pending and completed evaluations. Filters by standard/internal students. Shows evaluation queues with status badges.

nodes.label: Instructor Messages Page
nodes.description: Messaging interface for instructors. Thread list on left, conversation on right. Mobile responsive. Routes from students page via query param. Supports unread status tracking.

nodes.label: Instructor Overview Page
nodes.description: Main instructor dashboard. Shows welcome, programme filter chips, stats cards, programme overview table, evaluation queue preview, unread messages preview. Distinguishes standard students vs internal learners.

nodes.label: Instructor Students Page
nodes.description: Student roster table with search, programme filter, sort options, and pagination. Shows module progress, grades, test status, chat capability. Integrates student detail dialog.

nodes.label: Internal Portal Layout
nodes.description: Root layout for internal training portal. Wraps content with PortalStoreProvider and LearnerProvider. Configures internal programmes with role badges.

nodes.label: Internal Messages Page
nodes.description: Messages page wrapper for internal learners. Uses InstructorChat component with learner context to display chat interface.

nodes.label: Internal Dashboard Page
nodes.description: Default export from learner-content component. Main content area for internal portal learners.

nodes.label: Internal Settings Page
nodes.description: Default export from account-settings component. Settings page for internal portal users.

nodes.label: Root Layout
nodes.description: Application root layout. Sets up theme provider, query provider, placeholder provider, theme toggle, superuser bubble, and toast notifications. Handles dynamic page titles.

nodes.label: Login Page
nodes.description: Authentication page. Collects username/password, posts to /api/auth/login, navigates to role-specific home on success.

nodes.label: Root Home Page
nodes.description: Root path handler. Verifies session token from cookie, redirects to login if missing, otherwise redirects to role-specific home via ROLE_HOME.

nodes.label: Student Portal Layout
nodes.description: Root layout for student portal. Configures 2 programmes (M&A Consulting, Private Equity). Wraps with PortalStoreProvider and LearnerProvider.

nodes.label: Student Messages Page
nodes.description: Student messaging interface. Uses InstructorChat component with learner context to message instructors.

nodes.label: Student Dashboard Page
nodes.description: Default export from learner-content component. Main student learning dashboard.

nodes.label: Student Settings Page
nodes.description: Default export from account-settings component. Student account settings page.

nodes.label: Account Settings Component
nodes.description: Reusable account settings panel. Shows user info, name change form, credential reset functionality. Uses react-hook-form, zod validation, react-query mutations.

nodes.label: Learner Content Component
nodes.description: Main learning content view. Handles module navigation, resource display (videos/PDFs), quiz interactions, written exam, grades, and certificates. Fullscreen support for resources.

nodes.label: Learner Context Provider
nodes.description: React context managing all learner dashboard state. Provides programme/module navigation, progress tracking, quiz/written exam state, grades, completion logic. Persists progress to localStorage.

nodes.label: Learner Sidebar Components
nodes.description: Sidebar UI for learner portals. Exports LearnerSidebarContent and LearnerSidebarFooter. Content shows programme switcher, module navigation, progress bars. Footer shows messages, grades, certificate, settings.

nodes.label: Portal Shell Layout
nodes.description: Universal portal layout wrapper. Provides responsive sidebar, top bar, account menu, theme toggle, logout. Used by instructor, student, internal, and admin portals.

nodes.label: Server Auth Module
nodes.description: Core server-side authentication logic with JWT, password hashing, and role-based access control

nodes.label: Client Auth Module
nodes.description: Client-side authentication functions for session management and logout

nodes.description: MongoDB connection pool with caching strategy for efficient database access
